# Stellar Physio

> Stellar Physio is a leading physiotherapy and wellness clinic in Nairobi, Kenya, with over 12 years of experience and 152,000+ sessions completed. We treat back pain, sports injuries, stroke rehabilitation, and more.

## Important Pages
- [Home Page](https://stellarphysio.com): Main information and booking.
- [Services](https://stellarphysio.com/services): List of all specialized services (Physiotherapy, Chiropractic, etc.).
- [Conditions](https://stellarphysio.com/conditions): List of conditions we treat (Back Pain, Stroke Rehab, etc.).
- [Insurance & SHA](https://stellarphysio.com/insurance-and-sha): Information on accepted medical insurance providers.
- [Book Appointment](https://stellarphysio.com/book-appointment): Direct booking page.
- [Contact Us](https://stellarphysio.com/contact): Contact details for our 3 branches.

## About the Clinic
- **Locations:** Kenital Plaza (Ngong Road), Karen Country Club, Parklands Sports Club.
- **Hours:** Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat & Public Holidays 8am-4pm.
- **Emergency Home Visit:** Dial A Physio (+254 719 881 291).
